description:
## Goal

Port all upstream pi-mono documentation (from tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/) into the octo_pi project, adapting each doc to reflect our Elixir system while preserving the upstream reference for parity checking.

## Why

The upstream docs are the source of truth for pi-mono behavior. We need adapted versions that:
1. Reference our Elixir modules and functions instead of TypeScript APIs
2. Preserve upstream source file links for parity auditing
3. Document where our implementation diverges from upstream
4. Live in docs/ alongside our existing port-map docs

## Scope

23 upstream docs across these categories:

Core system (11 docs): compaction, session format, settings, providers, models, custom providers, extensions, RPC, SDK, packages, skills, prompt templates

TUI/UI (3 docs): TUI components, themes, keybindings

Setup/Config (6 docs): terminal setup, tmux, termux, Windows, shell aliases, development

Navigation/Reference (3 docs): tree navigation, JSON event stream, SDK

## Process

Each sub-ticket:
1. Read the upstream doc from tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/<name>.md
2. Create an adapted version in docs/<name>.md
3. Update all code references to our Elixir equivalents
4. Preserve upstream source links with pi-mono: filename notation
5. Note any divergence from upstream behavior
6. Keep the doc readable as a standalone reference

## Acceptance

All 23 docs ported, reviewed for accuracy, and linked from the project README or a docs index page.
title: Docs Migration: Port upstream pi-mono documentation to octo_pi
